q: Why is BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' risky for timestamps?
a: '2026-03-31' means midnight, so almost all of March 31 is excluded. Use a half-open range: >= '2026-03-01' AND < '2026-04-01'.

q: How do you compute a median without PERCENTILE_CONT?
a: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY x) and COUNT(*) OVER (); average the rows where rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2) using integer division.

q: How would you speed up a slow query?
a: Check EXPLAIN; read less (needed columns, filter early, partition pruning); sargable filters (don't wrap indexed columns in functions); index join/filter columns; aggregate before joins; replace correlated subqueries with joins or windows; UNION ALL over UNION.
A predicate the engine can answer using an index, e.g. order_date >= '2026-01-01'. Wrapping the column in a function (YEAR(order_date) = 2026) usually prevents index use.
